newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia PM says 4 pct growth to cut jobless.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia PM says 4 pct growth to cut jobless.

text.p: Australia needed economic growth of at least four percent to cut its troubling unemployment rate, Prime Minister John Howard said on Friday.
"Our level of unemployment is still too high," Howard said in opening a corporate park in Sydney.
"High growth, strong sustainable economic growth is still the best way to tackle unemployment," he said.
Official data released earlier this week showed gross domestic product grew 3.1 percent in the year to December.
Treasurer Peter Costello said growth remained on track for the government's forecast of 3.5 percent for the year to June 30, 1997.
The government has forecast unemployment at 8.5 percent by the end of fiscal 1996/97.
Howard's government has conceded unemployment remains one of its greatest challenges and failure to cut the jobless rate could cost the next election.
